chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: No friction yet between Buck, his wife and Bubbles
summary: During the Follies there was none; Buck's wife only complained later when bookings thinned.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: You were still married at this time, weren't you?
What was happening in terms of that relationship between Buck and his wife?

You did mention to me there was some friction at one time in terms of Buck's wife and what she felt you were doing in the act and how she was influencing Buck. Did anything happen with this kind of fame that was going on? Any additional friction?

Nothing was going on with them because of the fact that there was nothing she could say then. But this was after when the bookings were coming to be kind of nil for the amount of money we wanted to work and she would tell Buck that I'm trying to be better than he is. I don't know where she got that from, but anyway, that's what she had out with him.
